planRows.shortDesc: Unparalleled relaxation and renewal await where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez, on the southern tip of Mexico’s Baja California Peninsula. Enter paradise through the private Dos Mares tunnel for a luxurious stay at Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal, a Forbes Five-Star resort and spa carved into the mountain. Set on 24 acres, our resort is near the pristine Los Cabos beach at the heart of the activity.
planRows.headline: Cliffside paradise in Los Cabos
planRows.locationShortDesc: Seaside and cliffside, outside and in, The Waldorf Astoria Pedregal is the ultimate in luxury resorts, via Mexico’s only privately owned tunnel
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal is situated on the southern tip of the Baja California peninsula between San Jose Del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas, 45 minutes southwest of San Jose Del Cabo International Airport.
planRows.directionsTo: From SJD Intl. Airport, take the toll road to Cabo San Lucas and proceed to Downtown Cabo San Lucas. Turn left  onto Calle Cabo San Lucas. At the roundabout continue straight onto Blvd Paseo de la Marina. Turn right onto Camino del Mar (Pedregal Entrance) and turn left when you see the "Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal" sign (35 Km)

planRows.shortDesc: One block from the Cinta Costera and close to the financial district, our hotel offers luxury in the heart of the city. Surrounded by the nightlife of Calle Uruguay, restaurants and minutes from Casco Viejo, enjoy exclusive services such as our award-winning spa, modern fitness center, locally inspired cuisine and the only personal concierge in Panama certified by Les Clefs d'Or.
planRows.headline: Panama City views and Calle Uruguay nightlife
planRows.locationShortDesc: The Waldorf Astoria Panama is located blocks away from the City's Business District and steps away from a diversity of Restaurants & Pubs.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Your home away from home located in the heart of Panama City, offering calm rooms and True Waldorf Service. Featuring an outdoor pool, modern fitness center, Spa service, and delicious F&B options, you are sure to find all the details to create the best hotel stay of your life.
planRows.directionsTo: Exit the airport on Avenida Domingo Diaz heading towards Panama City. Approximately 2 miles, take the Corredor Sur (Pan American Highway) exit heading towards Panama City. Follow Corredor Sur for approximately 15 miles and take the Avenida Balboa exit (note, you will pass through 2 toll booths before seeing signs for Avenida Balboa). Follow Avenida Balboa approximately 2.5 miles and exit right onto Aquilino de la Guardia. Take Aquilino de la Guardia 1 block and turn left onto 47th St.

planRows.shortDesc: Nestled among lush mangroves, Waldorf Astoria Riviera Maya is a sanctuary of luxury, culture, and wellness. With 173 oceanfront rooms and suites, the resort offers transformative experiences inspired by the sacred Yaxché tree. Discover daily curated activities — from sunrise yoga to cultural rituals — and enjoy exclusive access to nearby championship golf courses. Refined accommodations, exceptional dining, and a deep connection to Riviera Maya’s spirit await.
planRows.headline: Welcome to the Riviera Maya’s Secret Treasure
planRows.locationShortDesc: The Waldorf Astoria Cancun is a beachfront property with 173 guest rooms and suites. The resort has 3 restaurants, 2 bars/lounges and a luxury Spa.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Experience a treasured beauty that brings meaning and enchantment to every moment.
planRows.directionsTo: From Airport- take Carretera Cancun-Chetumal 307 South.
